author: Arnav
problem: Read N and M sets of integers between 1 and N. Print how many of the 2^M ways to choose some of the sets give a union that contains every integer from 1 to N.
bug_description: Compares the union's size with m (the number of sets) instead of n.

comments.accurate: Tries every subset of the M sets and counts those whose union covers all N numbers
comments.wrong_behavior: Tries every subset of the M sets and counts those whose union holds exactly M numbers
comments.wrong_location: Union check verified; check the bitmask loop covers all 2^M subsets
